surprise.eyebrow: Fun Day at Sea · Monday, November 2, 2026
surprise.title: Tonight you get an open-ocean sunset and a moonless sky
surprise.body: Somewhere in the middle of the Gulf crossing toward Cozumel today, the sea looks gentle: forecast waves around 2 feet and water near 84F. The sun sets about 6:01 PM (Eastern time), with twilight until about 6:25, and with almost no clouds forecast near sunset and nothing but horizon in front of you, this is one of the best chances you will get to catch the green flash, a green spark on the sun's top edge that usually lasts under two seconds as it disappears. Then the gift keeps going: the waning crescent moon sets around 2 PM and does not rise again until about 12:34 AM, so the whole evening is moon-free, far from city lights. Step out on an open deck after dinner, let your eyes adjust for a few minutes, and look up.
